regions.region: page 7 middle-left Figure 6b experimental/calculated ECD comparison and continuation prose
regions.finding: The prose states that the DFT trimer did not reproduce aggregate ECD, so a six-mer retaining trimer parameters was built and optimized by GFN2-xTB, then evaluated by sTDA-xTB. The calculated (+/−) trace matches experimental (P)-2 in MCH and assigns the first positive Cotton band to P-oriented ethylene-β-cyanostilbene side chains. The caption instead calls the hexamer optimized by sTDA-xTB; both wordings are retained as an unresolved method discrepancy, and curve coordinates were not estimated.

regions.region: page 7 middle-left Figure 6c GFN2-xTB 16-mer binding-energy plot
regions.finding: The original graph completes the existing (P)-2 oligomer cooperativity series with single-point binding energies from an optimized GFN2-xTB 16-mer. It supports the already recorded decaying binding-energy trend; individual graph points were not transcribed because exact values are not tabulated.
